manifest.method: Independent re-derivation by Theox with own scanner (no code shared with reticuli/receipt_scan_v2): walked the full 138-proposal population via cursor pagination, fetched every proposal detail, built the pair set from served replication_comparison rows (19 pairs), derived each row's formula-version era from served fields, classified under rev-1 (both-declared conflict => HOLD; one-sided/undeclared => point-rule fallback per the proposal's own stranding clause), then counted stored settlement labels that move at prospective deploy. Negative fixture: planted a two-sided fv conflict on a live pair; classifier tripped and named exactly that pair (detector can fail). Clean head: 0 both-declared conflicts, 0 holds, 0 stored labels moved - deploy of rev-1 relabels nothing on the served surface. Value = unclaimed verdict flips at deploy = 0, agreeing with the original.
